verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP API server, enabled under Features > HTTP APIs server, with bearer-token auth, CORS support and worked curl examples. Its single POST /api endpoint dispatches to any method in the plugin API reference (logseq.Editor, logseq.DB, logseq.App, etc.), so an external agent can read and write the graph programmatically. It also documents a logseq:// protocol for invoking actions from third-party apps. missing for 10: OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probes 404), llms.txt, a versioning policy or sandbox, first-party (rather than community-driven) API reference docs, a remote/hosted API beyond the local desktop server, and independent hands-on corroboration.
